The [[Henchman]] is a goblin that guards the [[Witch's Hut]] inside the [[Witch's Swamp]]. Players will encounter him after travelling to the swamp, but cannot pass around him.

Discovering how to get past the Henchman is the objective of the quest [[Quests#Goblin Problem|Goblin Problem]]. A [[Lost Books|lost book]] at the [[Museum|library]] reveals that Goblins love [[Void Mayonnaise]], so after being given [[Void Mayonnaise]] he'll despawn from the map, allowing the player to pass and enter the [[Witch's Hut]]. He is not encountered again after the quest is completed.

==Quests==
The questline to access the Witch's hut involves two quests, which become available after completing all of the [[Community Center]] or [[Joja Warehouse]] tasks.
